operation.description: Registry lifecycle operation. Search must use dataset.search_experience_recipes.

recipeId.description: Recipe id for draft creation or metadata update during transition.

recipeVersion.description: Recipe version, for example draft, v1, or v2.

canonicalRecipeId.description: Canonical recipe family id used for governance dedupe.

businessType.description: Business problem family, for example crm_single_model_funnel or service_sla.

route.description: Preferred execution route, for example DSL_CTE, SQL, or MEMORY_GRID.

namespaceScope.description: Comma-separated namespace scope. Blank means globally discoverable.

tenantScope.description: Comma-separated tenant scope. Blank means all tenants allowed.

permissionTags.description: Comma-separated permission tags required for discovery.

ownerRole.description: Business owner role responsible for this recipe.

actorRole.description: Local/eval fallback only. Production callers should pass registry_admin through MCP context or X-Registry-Actor-Role.

idempotencyKey.description: Required idempotency key for exactly-once lifecycle mutation replay.

expectedFromActiveForDiscovery.description: Optional expected source discovery flag guard.

reason.description: Reason stored on the lifecycle event.

evidenceArtifacts.description: Evidence artifact references required by publish_validated. All five artifactType values must be present with artifactUri and artifactHash.

artifactId.description: Stable artifact id or external evidence id.

artifactType.description: Evidence type. publish_validated requires one valid artifact for every enum value.

artifactUri.description: URI or storage key pointing to the signed evidence artifact.

signedBy.description: Actor or role that signed the artifact.

governanceEvidence.description: Publish gate evidence. publish_validated requires every status to be passed and every required evidence artifact type to be present.
